cmd:
echo ===DF===; df -h /
echo ===DU-OPT===; sudo du -sh /opt/* 2>/dev/null | sort -rh
echo ===DU-REPO-TOP===; du -sh /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/.git 2>/dev/null; du -sh /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/data 2>/dev/null
echo ===DU-DATA-TOP20===; du -sh /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/data/* 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -20
echo ===GIT-COUNT-OBJECTS===; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && git count-objects -vH
echo ===LOGS===; sudo du -sh /var/log/vps-*.log 2>/dev/null; sudo ls -la /var/log/ | grep -i vps
echo ===DU-ETC===; sudo du -sh /etc/vps-* 2>/dev/null
echo ===JOURNALCTL-SIZE===; sudo journalctl --disk-usage 2>/dev/null
echo ===LARGEST-FILES-REPO===; find /opt/weather-pipeline/repo -type f -not -path "*/.git/*" -printf "%s %p\n" 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -20
